notes.title: New Turf, New Terrors: Jim’s Nightmare Episode 2 Drops Now!
notes.notes:
[b]New Turf, New Terrors: Jim’s Nightmare Episode 2 Drops Now
[/b]

Hey, gangster fellows,
It’s time to buckle up and dive deeper into the dark underbelly of the city with Jim’s Nightmare: Chapter 1 Episode 2—now live and ready for action. Jim and Timothy are rolled into Marwood, a city now under the ruthless thumb of the Minacs. It’s a new turf, and the dangers are sharper than ever as they dig up the dirt on the shadowy figure hunting them.

[b]What’s Going Down in Episode 2:[/b]
Take Over Marwood: Jim and Timothy have hit the streets of Marwood, a city transformed into a crime-ridden cesspool by the Minacs. The place is crawling with threats and dark secrets just waiting to be uncovered.
Dangerous Streets: The city’s back alleys and grimy corners are packed with danger. As you navigate Marwood, expect trouble at every turn and keep your wits about you.
Tough Puzzles: Confront puzzles that will push your brain to its limits. These aren’t your run-of-the-mill riddles—only the sharpest minds will crack them and unearth the crucial clues.
High-Stakes Gameplay: From nerve-wracking chases to survival horror and detective work, this chapter keeps you on your toes. Shape Jim’s fate with RPG elements as you piece together the story and fight to stay alive.
[b]Ready to Roll? The new chapter is live and waiting for you.
[/b]
[list]
[*] From the Streets: This episode cranks up the heat and takes Jim’s nightmare to the next level. We’re itching to see how you handle the fresh challenges and dark twists.
[*] Join the Discussion: Drop your thoughts and feedback in our Community. Your take on the game helps us keep pushing the envelope.
[*] What’s Next: Marwood’s just the beginning. Keep your eyes peeled for more updates as we continue to dig deeper into Jim’s relentless nightmare.
[*] Thanks for Riding with Us, Your support fuels the fight against the shadows. Step into Chapter 1 and let the chaos reign.
[/list]
With Grit and Guts,
The Pumpkiny Team

notes.title: Jim's Nightmare Chapter 01 v1.4.5
notes.notes:
Hello, gangsters!

Thank you for joining us in early access for "[b]Jim's Nightmare: Chapter 1[/b]". We appreciate your support and feedback as we continue to improve your gaming experience.

[h2]Patch Notes for Version 1.4.5:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Improved walking system for smoother navigation.
[*]     Enhanced accessibility and user experience features.
[*]     Updated user interface for a more intuitive experience.
[*]     Added a comprehensive settings menu.
[*]     Fixed various art issues.
[*]     Corrected missing lines of dialogue.
[*]     Updated wall colliders for better interaction.
[*]     Enhanced the option to skip dialogues.
[*]     Refined the tutorial for new players.
[*]     Fixed numerous small bugs for a smoother gameplay.
[*]     Resolved issues with the sanity mechanic.
[*]     Improved monster attack behaviors for a more challenging experience.
[/list]

This update focuses primarily on debugging and refining the game based on your valuable feedback.

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

The Pumpkiny Games and Sky Den Games Teams!
